reasons: Cited Section 22 is the operative audit right binding Customer and matches the preferred position on every material term: once per 12 months, 30 days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality (p0087).
Cost allocation sits with Vendor unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and direct access to Customer systems is expressly barred (p0088), satisfying the cost and no-system-access elements.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment was proposed and the rendered text is unchanged; deterministic check on audit frequency passes.
